name: [将] Shogun's Reign
desc:
⚔️ [将] SHOGUN'S REIGN 🏯

From the fields to the throne, your destiny is yours to claim.

Welcome to [将] Shogun's Reign, a roleplaying and progression experience inspired by the world of Edo-period Japan. This game contains fantasy elements and is not intended to be historically accurate.

🌾 Work the fields. Earn your first Ryō through farming, labor, and humble trades.

🏮 Find your place. Explore bustling towns, mountain villages, shrines, estates, and the dangerous roads that connect them.

⚔️ Rise through society. Build your wealth and reputation, master a profession, serve those above you, or take a more dangerous path toward power.

🏯 Climb the ranks. Become a respected warrior, influential noble, or powerful feudal lord as you compete with others for status and authority.

👑 Claim the Shogunate. At the very top stands one position above all others: Shogun. Gain enough influence, wealth, and power, and the realm itself may one day fall under your rule.
